To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

“e3-value is a conceptual modelling approach that supports the definition, analysis and evaluation of e-business models, and is a useful tool for the business executives who define and roll out e-business models”.
e3-value is a lightweight, value-oriented methodology for e-business modelling, that is based on a value-oriented ontology.
the e3-value approach is a conceptual modelling methodology that enables the definition and analysis of e-business models, which is a prerequisite for e-business roll-out projects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the definition of a rigorous, value-oriented approach for e-business modelling.

the development of e-business modelling techniques that support the definition of e-business models, the derivation of business operations, and the analysis of the business value that is created by the e-business.
the definition and analysis of multi-enterprise e-business scenarios.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our e3value approach is useful to design and evaluate e-business models.
the e3-value methodology offers an integrated approach to the definition and operationalization of e-business models.
e3-value is a powerful and practical approach to the design and evaluation of e-business models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that a rigorous, conceptual approach to e-business modelling is feasible and can be applied in practice.

e3-value offers an effective and efficient way for the business executives to understand and communicate the e-business model to the various stakeholders, while at the same time offering the technical developers an unambiguous and comprehensive understanding of the operational requirements for the e-business model, and thus a better chance for success.

the e3-value methodology offers a more rigorous, value-oriented approach to e-business modelling, that supports the definition of e-business models and scenarios in a more structured and systematic way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the e3-value approach can be used by business executives and IT specialists to improve the definition and roll-out of e-business models.
e-business models should not be left to the imagination and intuition of the business stakeholders and the developers, but be defined and evaluated rigorously, using a value-oriented approach.

a value-based, rigorous approach to the definition and analysis of e-business models can significantly improve the communication and understanding of the e- business issues, and can help to avoid costly mistakes and delays during e-business roll-out.
